title: ItAnt Oscan Corpus
description:
ItAnt Oscan Corpus is the digital corpus of new critical editions of a selection of inscriptions in the Oscan language, created as part of the PRIN 2017 project 'Languages and Cultures of Ancient Italy. Historical Linguistics and Digital Models'. The inscriptions are represented in XML using the TEI/EpiDoc encoding scheme, enriched with shared and standardized metadata, thus allowing for an accurate description of each inscription as both a linguistic and material object. The corpus also includes a facsimile reproduction of the inscriptions.

 

The project is supported by the Ministero dell'Università e della Ricerca, Italy [PRIN 2017XJLE8J]
